title: Setting road and rail against each other

sections.title: What is new
sections.content: You know *ezzel szemben* and *viszont* from B1 Unit 11, *mindazonáltal* from B2 Unit 16, *míg* from B1 Citizenship Unit 2 and *szemben* from earlier units. They contrast two ways of travelling: *A busz a városon belül gyors, a vonat viszont a távolsági utakon.* What is new in this lesson is the vocabulary of modal shift and the frame *a kamionforgalommal szemben a vasút …* ('in contrast with truck traffic, rail …').

sections.title: Example
sections.content: Example: *Míg a kamion a közúton halad, addig a tehervonat a síneken.* In *a kamionforgalommal szemben* the thing you set against takes *-val/-vel*.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A környezetszennyező kamionforgalommal szemben a vasút energiatakarékos.
In contrast with polluting truck traffic rail is energy-saving.
A busz a városon belül gyors, a vonat viszont a távolsági utakon.
The bus is fast inside the city; the train, however, on long-distance journeys.
Míg a kamion a közúton halad, addig a tehervonat a síneken.
While the truck runs on the road, the freight train runs on rails.
